properties.name: campus.security.jwt-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret used to sign JWT tokens. Use a private value in local environment files.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.jdbc-url
properties.description: JDBC URL for the PostgreSQL pgvector database.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.username
properties.description: Username for the PostgreSQL pgvector database.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.password
properties.description: Password for the PostgreSQL pgvector database. Prefer environment variables in real deployments.

properties.name: campus.vector.datasource.driver-class-name
properties.description: JDBC driver class for the pgvector datasource.

properties.name: campus.vector.dimensions
properties.description: Embedding vector dimensions used by the pgvector table.

properties.name: campus.vector.initialize-schema
properties.description: Whether to let Spring AI initialize the pgvector schema.

properties.name: campus.upload.max-characters
properties.description: Maximum characters accepted for a text material upload.
